title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
teachers:
KAMADA Hiroshi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will be explore their future career paths, set goals for higher education and employment that are suitable for them, and become motivated to voluntarily begin the preparations and measures necessary to achieve those goals.
advice:
In this course, students will learn the following items:
1. Career design recommendations
2. How to write an essay
3. Self-analysis
4. Aptitude test
5. Self-inspection
6. Making use of what they learned in the Department of Media Information in the information society
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminars I and II, which are held in the first and second semesters, are lectures for career activities in the next fiscal year, and are held to prepare students to take necessary measures, make preparations for severe employment conditions, and/or for going on to graduate school. All students are required to take these courses regardless of their future advancement or employment prospects, as preparation for career planning, employment, and advancement.

activityGoals.body: Be able to deeply consider the relationship between life design and career path.
Be able to think and act optimally to find the path that best suits oneself.
Be able to explain logically so that others can understand the policies and goals related to your career path.
Be able to investigate the knowledge, ability, skills, qualifications, etc. necessary to achieve the goals.
